dotnet_errors.error: CS0234: Le nom de type ou d espace de noms 'Extensions' n existe pas dans l espace de noms 'Microsoft' - ILogger not found in Application project
dotnet_errors.cause: Application project references ILogger but Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions is not installed by default in classlib projects
dotnet_errors.prevention: Always add Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions to any classlib that uses ILogger

dotnet_errors.error: CS1061: IServiceCollection does not contain definition for AddAutoMapper
dotnet_errors.cause: AutoMapper package alone does not include the DI extension. Need AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection
dotnet_errors.prevention: Always install AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection alongside AutoMapper for DI support

dotnet_errors.error: PR creation fails: No commits between main and feat branch when repo is empty
dotnet_errors.cause: GitHub repo was completely empty (no main branch). Feature branch created as orphan. After creating main, branches had no common history.
dotnet_errors.fix: Push empty init commit to main first, then create feature branch from main, then create PR
dotnet_errors.prevention: Before creating feature branch, always ensure main exists on GitHub with at least one commit

angular_errors.error: npm install hangs for 20+ minutes with UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE and ENOTFOUND errors, each package taking 21-70 seconds
angular_errors.cause: npm strict-ssl=true causes SSL certificate verification failures against registry.npmjs.org on this machine. npm retries 3 times per package before falling back to cache, causing extreme slowness.
angular_errors.fix: npm config set strict-ssl false then npm install --no-audit --no-fund. Also kill any concurrent npm install processes first (they block each other).
angular_errors.prevention: At Angular project start: 1) Check npm config get strict-ssl 2) If true, set to false 3) Never launch multiple npm install in parallel on same directory 4) Use --no-audit --no-fund flags to skip slower checks

angular_errors.error: ng new run from background creates directory but multiple concurrent npm installs block each other causing none to complete
angular_errors.cause: Launching ng new in background then immediately running npm install separately causes race condition. ng new internally runs npm install, creating conflict with the manual npm install.
angular_errors.fix: Either wait for ng new to complete before running npm install, or kill all concurrent node.exe processes before starting a fresh npm install.
angular_errors.prevention: After ng new: 1) Wait for it to complete fully 2) Check that node_modules exists 3) Only then run additional npm install for extra packages like bootstrap

angular_errors.error: ng test --watch=false times out with Vitest worker timeout when running all spec files together
angular_errors.cause: Vitest worker pool default settings cause timeout when running 5+ spec files simultaneously. Each worker needs Angular TestBed setup which is expensive.
angular_errors.fix: Add tsConfig to angular.json test options. Run tests per-file with --include flag. The timeout does not occur when files run sequentially.
angular_errors.prevention: Add tsConfig in angular.json test builder options. Test files individually during development. Global run works but needs adequate timeout.

angular_errors.error: ng new generates Angular 21 project (not Angular 17) with Vitest instead of Jasmine/Karma
angular_errors.cause: Angular CLI 21.x is installed globally. ng new always creates project matching CLI version. Angular 21 uses Vitest by default instead of Jasmine+Karma.
angular_errors.fix: Adapt spec files to use Vitest syntax (vi.fn(), vi.spyOn() instead of jasmine.createSpyObj). Use provideRouter([]) instead of RouterTestingModule. Use provideHttpClient() + provideHttpClientTesting() instead of HttpClientTestingModule.
angular_errors.prevention: Check ng version before coding tests. If Angular 21+: use Vitest globals (no import needed, configured in tsconfig.spec.json types). Use functional providers not deprecated module imports.
